page.overview:
Who is Security 1?

Security 1 is a videogame character appearing in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Wheelie Breakers.

Security 1 is available as an opponent from the start of the game. He can be faced in an alternate version of the first event of Story Mode if the player chooses to replay the storyline.
